title: The Glory of the Lord Leaves the Temple

questions.question: What did Ezekiel see above the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim?
options: There appeared above them something like a sapphire, in form resembling a throne
A bright cloud that shielded the sun
A host of angels singing praises
The likeness of a man with eyes of fire
questions.correctAnswer: There appeared above them something like a sapphire, in form resembling a throne
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:1 (ESV): "Then I looked, and behold, on the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim there appeared above them something like a sapphire, in form resembling a throne."

questions.question: What command was given to the man clothed in linen regarding the whirling wheels?
options: "Go in among the whirling wheels underneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals... and scatter them over the city."
"Remove the wheels and cast them outside the city."
"Measure the wheels to construct the new temple."
"Pour water on the burning coals to save the remnant."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go in among the whirling wheels underneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals... and scatter them over the city."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:2 (ESV): "And he said to the man clothed in linen, 'Go in among the whirling wheels underneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.'"

questions.question: Where were the cherubim standing when the man went in?
options: On the south side of the house
On the north side of the altar
In the Holy of Holies
At the eastern gate
questions.correctAnswer: On the south side of the house
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:3 (ESV): "Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the house, when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court."

questions.question: While the man went in, what happened to the glory of the Lord?
options: It went up from the cherub to the threshold of the house
It disappeared completely
It filled the man with power
It spoke with a voice like thunder
questions.correctAnswer: It went up from the cherub to the threshold of the house
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:4 (ESV): "And the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub to the threshold of the house, and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord."

questions.question: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, and it sounded like what?
options: The voice of God Almighty when he speaks
The rushing of many waters
A mighty windstorm
The crash of an earthquake
questions.correctAnswer: The voice of God Almighty when he speaks
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:5 (ESV): "And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks."

questions.question: How did the man clothed in linen get the fire? Who gave it to him?
options: A cherub reached out his hand, took some fire, and put it into the hands of the man
He picked it up with golden tongs
It fell from the throne into his hands
He scooped it up himself from the ground
questions.correctAnswer: A cherub reached out his hand, took some fire, and put it into the hands of the man
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:7 (ESV): "And a cherub reached out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it and put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen,"

questions.question: What appeared under the wings of the cherubim?
options: The form of a human hand
A sword of fire
A golden seal
A measuring line
questions.correctAnswer: The form of a human hand
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:8 (ESV): "The cherubim appeared to have the form of a human hand under their wings."

questions.question: What did the wheels beside the cherubim look like?
options: They appeared like the gleaming of a beryl
They looked like molten bronze
They were black like obsidian
They shone like pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: They appeared like the gleaming of a beryl
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:9 (ESV): "and the appearance of the wheels was like the gleaming of a beryl."

questions.question: How many wheels were there?
options: Four, one beside each cherub
Two, spinning together
Twelve, one for each tribe
Seven, with eyes all around
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:9 (ESV): "And I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one beside each cherub,"

questions.question: What was full of eyes all around?
options: Their whole body, their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels
Only the wheels
Only the faces of the cherubim
The floor of the expanse
questions.correctAnswer: Their whole body, their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:12 (ESV): "And their whole body, their backs, their hands, and their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around—the wheels that the four of them had."

questions.question: What were the wheels called in Ezekiel's hearing?
options: "The whirling wheels"
"The chariots of wrath"
"The cycles of time"
"The gears of heaven"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:13 (ESV): "As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing 'the whirling wheels.'"

questions.question: Each cherub had four faces. The first face was the face of a cherub. What were the second, third, and fourth?
options: Human, lion, eagle
Ox, human, eagle
Lion, bear, leopard
Human, eagle, ox
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:14 (ESV): "And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of the cherub, and the second face was a human face, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle."

questions.question: Where did Ezekiel recognize these living creatures from?
options: They were the living creatures he saw by the Chebar canal
He had seen them in Solomon's temple
They were described in the Torah
He had dreamed of them as a child
questions.correctAnswer: They were the living creatures he saw by the Chebar canal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:15 (ESV): "And the cherubim mounted up. These were the living creatures that I saw by the Chebar canal."

questions.question: What significant spiritual departure takes place in verse 18?
options: The glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim
The Spirit left Ezekiel and returned to heaven
The Lord abandoned the ark of the covenant
The fire on the altar went out permanently
questions.correctAnswer: The glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:18 (ESV): "Then the glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim."

questions.question: Where did the cherubim stand as they lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth?
options: At the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord
On the Mount of Olives
In the valley of Kidron
By the river Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: At the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:19 (ESV): "And they stood at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them."

key_verse_text: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim. And the cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight as they went out, with the wheels beside them. And they stood at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
